subject: Switchboard Activation: Pre-cutover Playback & Post-activation Readout
body:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Miguel Santos <msantos@arcadia-health.com>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@partnercloud.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Switchboard activation: pre-cutover playback & checklist

Team,

We have a final runbook playback for the Switchboard private deployment (Arcadia Health VPC peering + on-prem appliance) tomorrow. Goal: full activation window, run smoke scripts, validate routing and observability, then hand to Arcadia for their validation. Please review and confirm the items below by EOD today.

Key asks:
- Marissa: verify runbook steps 3.1-3.6 (BGP session flaps and peering acceptance) and the ACL matrix.
- Vivek: confirm firewall rule updates and NAT/egress IP list; check service autoscale window is set to 90s.
- Karthik: prepare the smoke test harness and the KV-cache priming step (script attached).
- Miguel / Arcadia Ops: confirm your VPN BFD timers and provide the external validation IPs for connectivity checks.

Attachments (drafts):
- switchboard_runbook_v2.md (runbook)
- network_acl_matrix.xlsx (ACL/port mapping)
- smoke_test_script.sh (smoke harness & priming)

Schedule (PST):
- 08:00 — pre-cutover connectivity (Arcadia + Redwood)
- 09:00 — canary activation (5% weight)
- 09:30 — progressive ramp to 100% over 20 minutes
- 10:00 — smoke validation & sampling

If anyone sees a blocker, call it out now. Otherwise assume the playbook proceeds as written.

-Jasmine

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Miguel Santos <msantos@arcadia-health.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Switchboard activation: pre-cutover playback & checklist

Thanks Jasmine — I reviewed runbook v2.

Couple of notes:
- I updated step 3.3 to include an explicit BGP neighbor reset after the peering accept; left rationale in the doc.
- Can someone confirm the expected egress IPs for Arcadia so we can add them to our NAT exception list? I don't want the observability probes to be blocked.
- Observability playbook: will sample traces at 10s granularity for the first 30 minutes. If we see >1% 5xx we rollback immediately to the previous allocation.

I attached a short checklist to the runbook for the network ops war room.

-Marissa

To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Miguel Santos <msantos@arcadia-health.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Switchboard activation: pre-cutover playback & checklist

I pushed the firewall change set and verified rule ordering for the intra-VPC paths. Notes:
- NAT egress IPs for Redwood test agents: 34.82.193.45, 34.82.193.46 (these will be used for active probes).
- Autoscale window adjusted to 90s as requested.
- Canary rollout policy: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 10-minute observation windows between escalations.

I'll be on standby during the activation and will monitor connectivity and ACL counters.

-Vivek

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Switchboard activation: pre-cutover playback & checklist

Jasmine,

Arcadia Ops will join the 08:00 connectivity window. Confirmed items from our side:
- VPN BFD timers: min 300ms, multihop OK.
- External validation IPs: 203.0.113.12, 203.0.113.13 (we'll run curl + TLS probe and a simple application-level POST to /healthz).
- We'll provide a short network capture if we see any BGP flapping on our edge.

One ask: if you hit the KV priming step, please tag the messages with X-Trace-ID so our tracing correlator can join the spans.

-Miguel

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Miguel Santos <msantos@arcadia-health.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Post-activation smoke: initial observations and logs

Team,

Quick post-cutover readout from the smoke harness (attached log). Summary:
- Canary passed (no errors) and progressive ramp to 100% completed at 09:22 PST.
- Smoke tests: basic RTT, TLS handshake, token-based auth, and per-route latency checks passed.
- Observability: sampling shows median p95 token latency increased by ~12ms under light load — within expected variance.

Issues found:
1) KV-cache priming: first-connection cold cache resulted in 502s for ~0.7% of requests during the priming window. Root cause appears to be the priming ordering: cache priming happens after a small percentage of requests route to the new nodes. I recommend adjusting runbook step 5.2 to pre-warm the cache from a synthetic trace before canary.
2) Node replacement: one worker returned repeated 502 under sustained concurrent priming; we cycled the node and it rejoined cleanly. Node-level logs attached.

Next steps:
- Jasmine / Product ops: update runbook to include an explicit pre-warm script and a 2-minute wait after priming before increasing canary.
- Engineering: investigate fast-fail behavior on the worker that showed 502s; I created ticket INF-3629 for triage.

Attachments:
- switchboard_smoke_20270722.log
- node-logs-worker-7.txt

-Karthik

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Miguel Santos <msantos@arcadia-health.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Switchboard activation: pre-cutover playback & checklist — closure

Thanks all — good execution.

Summary and closure notes:
- Go-live: successful. Canary -> 100% completed with rollback guard in place and one transient node replacement.
- Follow-ups:
  * Runbook change: add pre-warm step before canary (Karthik to draft update; Marissa to approve).
  * Engineering ticket INF-3629 for node failure analysis (assigned to infra-team).
  * Observability tweak: increase trace sampling to 20s granularity for first 60 minutes on future activations.

I've uploaded the smoke logs to the playbook folder and attached the primary log to this thread.

Attachments:
- switchboard_smoke_20270722.log

-Jasmine
